children: may hover above support at $2.7835 per lb for one or two days, or bounce into a range of $2.8365 to $2.8755.
The support is identified as the 100% projection level of a wave (c) from $3.1735. The former support at $2.8365, the 86.4% level, triggered a decent bounce.
The current support may be stronger, especially as it coincides with the completion of a small five-wave cycle from $2.9275.
A break below $2.7835 may open the way toward the $2.6915 to $2.7560 range.
* The coffee report is published twice a week on Tuesday and Thursday.
